note: make worktree-take HANDS YOU A target/ THAT SERVES STALE BINARIES WITH THE PREVIOUS CAMPAIGNS PATH BAKED IN, AND THE RESULT IS SPURIOUS REDS THAT LOOK LIKE A RED MAIN. Measured today taking the-axes -> the-staff. worktree-take RENAMES the pool directory and PRESERVES target/ (that is the whole point, a cold build is 771 s). But env!(CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR) and CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR are baked AT COMPILE TIME, and cargo does not consider a renamed worktree a reason to rebuild - cargo build --workspace --all-targets reported everything fresh. So every cached test binary still points at the OLD directory. 31 files under kernel/ domains/ windows/ cli/ use one of those two macros. I got SIX failures that are pure artifacts: hornvale-alchemy::draws_nothing domain_draws_nothing, hornvale-worldgen::proto_goblinoid_golden (x2), hornvale-terrain::channel_golden the_channel_network_is_pinned, hornvale-vessel::session_snapshot (x2). The panic names the old path outright: reading /Users/.../worktrees/the-axes/domains/alchemy/src: No such file or directory. POSITIVE CONTROL, same commit same tree: cached binary FAIL, then touch domains/alchemy/tests/draws_nothing.rs and it PASSES. WHAT TO DO: after make worktree-take, force a rebuild of anything fixture-reading before you trust a red - touch the test sources, or accept the cold build. AND: do not report a red from a freshly recycled worktree as a red main until you have rebuilt. Main is NOT red on these.
